question: What must be specified to answer where all things go to dissolution and to have that full account disclosed?
premises: An inquiry is made as to in what all things go to dissolution.
The particle ca-eva marks that inquiry as emphatic.
A request is made to tell all of that to the speaker.
inference: A full account is requested of the locus in which all things undergo dissolution.
uncertainties: Locus of dissolution not specified in this verse
plain_english: And indeed, in what does all this go to dissolution? Tell me all of that.
